newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Guilford started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Guilford started as buy.

text.p: --Vector Securities International Inc said Friday it initiated coverage of Guilford Pharmaceuticals Inc with a buy rating and a 12-month price target on the stock of $30.
--Guilford Pharmaceuticals is a Baltimore, Md.-based biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery and development of therapeutic and diagnostic products for neurological disorders.
--"We believe Guilford is well positioned as a mid cap biotech stock poised to enter the commercial phase of development," Vector analyst Peter Drake noted in a report.
